readings.Aries: Rest is not retreat. Your system needs to cycle before it can perform at capacity again. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Taurus: There is something beautiful in your immediate environment that you've stopped seeing. Look again. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Gemini: The idea you dismissed too quickly deserves another look. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Cancer: You carry the emotional history of everyone you love. Set some of it down today. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Leo: Someone who competed with you has moved on. You haven't. Notice this. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Virgo: The pursuit of precision is a form of care. Let it be received as such today. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: You want harmony. You also want honesty. Today they are in conflict. Choose honesty. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Scorpio: Your silence is more legible than you think. What you're not saying has already been read. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Sagittarius: The horizon is real. It is also not the point. What is between here and there? Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Capricorn: Something you've been building alone could go faster with help. Asking is not weakness. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Aquarius: Your tolerance for the unconventional is high. Your tolerance for being ordinary, in one small way, is lower than it should be. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Pisces: You absorb the moods and needs of spaces and people automatically. Today, set down what you've absorbed. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
